executiveSummary.headline: Clean scan — no blocking mock/fiction findings in configured paths.

complianceChecklist.title: Simplebeacon Corporate Safety Checklist
complianceChecklist.description: Automated guardrails for AI-generated code — maps scan signals to deploy readiness.

summary.headline: 10/10 applicable rules pass — safe to enable automated AI deploy gates

rules.title: Merge gate passes on configured severities
rules.remediation: Fix blocking findings and re-run: npx simplebeacon scan --gate
rules.evidence: Gate pass — no blocking issues at configured severities

rules.title: No credential or secret patterns in scanned paths
rules.remediation: Remove secrets from the repo, rotate exposed credentials, add patterns to .gitignore

rules.title: No mock/sample JSON paths referenced from production directories
rules.remediation: Replace hardcoded *-sample.json paths with repository-audit APIs or env-based config
rules.evidence: Scanned 0 production file(s) — no sample-path leaks

rules.title: Registered page samples match schema specs
rules.remediation: Fix schema violations listed in the scan report

rules.title: No fiction KPI or baseline drift in anchor samples
rules.remediation: Replace fiction metrics with repository-audit baseline values
rules.evidence: Consistency score 100% — no fiction KPI drift

rules.title: No critical or high npm audit vulnerabilities
rules.remediation: Run npm audit fix; upgrade transitive dependencies blocking CVEs

rules.title: Moderate npm vulnerabilities within policy limit
rules.remediation: Upgrade dependencies flagged by npm audit (moderate severity)

rules.title: Production profile has JWT auth enabled (REQUIRE_AUTH)
rules.remediation: Set REQUIRE_AUTH=true and real JWT secrets in .env.production on the deploy host

rules.title: Directory bloat reviewed and safe-to-delete items identified
rules.remediation: Review directory bloat findings in data-cleanup scan and remove safe-to-delete items
rules.evidence: No directory bloat detected — codebase is clean

rules.title: Empty directories identified for removal
rules.remediation: Remove empty directories flagged by the directory scanner

rules.title: File reduction findings reviewed
rules.remediation: Review file reduction scan results and clean up unused files, duplicates, and build artifacts
rules.evidence: No file reduction findings — no cleanup needed

credentials.summary: No credential patterns detected in scanned paths.

fictionKpis.summary: No fiction KPI or consistency drift detected.

productionLeaks.summary: No mock/sample path references in production directories.

schemaDrift.summary: All registered page samples match schema specs.

immediate: Add simplebeacon scan --gate to PR workflow (see docs/GITHUB-ACTION-QUICKSTART.md)
next30Days: Review production-leak allowlist for intentional seed files
Run consolidation scan to dedupe identical sample JSON

keepUsing: Snyk or GitHub Advanced Security for CVEs
addSimplebeaconFor: Hardcoded sample paths in production directories
